name: Rahul Agarwal
title: Founder, Fundaking Media · SEO consultant in Pune
bio: Fundaking Media (Rahul Agarwal) is an SEO consulting firm in Pune / Baramati helping Indian B2B, SaaS, D2C and local businesses with technical SEO, local SEO, and AI-search visibility. Rahul works directly with founders — audits, roadmaps, and advisory tied to enquiries, not vanity rankings.
